title.narrative: Administration Agreement with the International Finance Corporation for Strengthening the Angola Incubation and Entrepreneurship

description.narrative: The Angola¿s intervention aims to foster decent job creation and sustainable livelihoods in Angola by catalysing an entrepreneurial environment and supporting business incubators, mainly on two components: 1) expand the Accelerator Offering in Fintech/digital space and 2) support the establishment and operationalization of an Agro-incubator. The project is going to be implemented by the International Finance Corporation and is expected to start on the last quarter of 2021, for a period of four years, in direct support to two incubators in two provinces (prospectively in Luanda and in Huambo). The program ultimate goal is to contribute to better and inclusive access to markets and/or value chains by startups and entrepreneurs. In turn, this is expected to help foster decent job creation and sustainable livelihoods in Angola (especially for the youth and women entrepreneurs).

title.narrative: Component 2: Support the establishment and operationalization of an Agroincubator.

description.narrative: The objective of this component is to support the establishment and operationalization of an Agroincubator connected with two IFC clients (Anchor Firms). These clients are expanding their feed and poultry operations and intend to develop poultry out growers for an integrated business model. This will promote the surge of an MSME broiler rearing sector in Angola
